top: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus,
And be not conformed to this world:
bottom: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind...

top: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy
bottom: and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope...

top: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God,
bottom: and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?

top: For ye are bought with a price:
bottom: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit...

top: ...God is faithful... with the temptation also
bottom: make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

top: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three;
bottom: but the greatest of these is charity.
